sa: तमब्रवीन्महातेजा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। गच्छ यत्नपरश्चाप भव लक्ष्मण संयुगे॥
en: To him replied Rāma of exceeding energy, having truth for his prowess, “Go then O Lakşmaņa, and put forth your utmost exertions in the encounter.

sa: विधास्ये येन गन्तासि विषहिष्येऽप्यहं तथा। न ग्राहा विधमिष्यन्ति यावत्सेना तरिष्यति।। हरीणां तरणे राम करिष्यामि यथा स्थलम्॥
en: I will tell you how you will pass (over me); or and I will bear it. And no ferocious aquatic animals shall do wrong so long as your forces have not crossed. And, O Rāma, I will make as it were firm land for the crossing over of the monkeys.

sa: रावणस्तु परं चक्रे क्रोधं प्रासादधर्षणात्। विनाशं चात्मनः पश्यन्निःश्वासपरमोऽभवत्॥
en: Rāvana was transported with wrath in consequence of the breaking down of the palace. And, finding his destruction (at hand), he began to heave sighs.

sa: तत्रापि संध्यामन्वास्य वासविः सहरीश्वरः। किष्किन्धामभितो गृह्य रावणं पुनरागमत्॥
en: And having recited his prayers there also, Vali, the son of Indra, and the king of monkeys, carrying Rāvana, returned to the city of Kişikindhā.

sa: अगस्त्यस्त्वब्रवीद्रामं सर्वमेतछुतं त्वया। दृष्टः संभाषितश्चासि राम गच्छामहे वयम्॥
en: Agastya told Rāma, all this has been heard by you. We have also seen you and conversed with you. Now we shall make a more.

sa: ऊचुश्च परमक्रुद्धाः प्रगृह्याशु परश्वधान्। नेयमर्हति भर्तारं रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्॥
en: Taking up instantly spears, they exceedingly wroth, menaced her, saying— "she is not worthy of having Rāvana, the lord of the Rākşasas, as her lord."

sa: पराङ्मुखे कृते देवे मालिना गरुडेन वै। उदतिष्ठन्महाशब्दो रक्षसामभिनर्दताम्॥
en: On the god having been removed from the field by Mäli as well as Garuda, there arose a mighty din of Raksasa roaring (in chorus).

sa: सुस्कन्धविटपैः शैलैः शिलाभिश्च महाबलः। हनूमान्कदनं चक्रे रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्॥
en: The highly powerful monkeys destroyed his retinue, with crags, stones and trees having strong trunks. And Hanumān thus crushed many a Rākşasa of terrible deeds.

sa: रामसुग्रीवयोरैक्यं देव्येवं समजायत। हनूमन्तं च मां विद्धि तयोर्दूतमुपागतम्॥
en: In this way, O dame, the alliance between Rāma and Sugrīva was made. And know me as Hanumān, their messenger who has come to you.

sa: बद्धाञ्जलिपुटं दीनं याचन्तं शरणागतम्। न हन्यादानृशंस्यार्थमपि शत्रु परंतप॥
en: o slayer of foes, even a wicked-minded enemy, if he, with folded palms and a poor heart, crave for your shelter, should not be slain.

sa: ततः पादपमुक्तेन पुष्पवर्षेण वीर्यवान्। अभिवृष्टस्ततस्तत्र बभौ पुष्पमयो हरिः॥
en: And covered with showers of blossoms poured down by the trees, that monkey possessed of prowess then appeared there like Puspamaya.* *A monkey so named.

sa: स(रुष्टैः खरैश्चैव सिंहद्विपमृगद्विजैः। अनुजग्मुश्च तं घोरं कुम्भकर्ण महाबलम्॥
en: And mounting serpents and camels and asses and lions and leopards and deer and birds, (Rāks asas) followed the grim Kumbhakarņa endowed with tremendous strength.

sa: महत्सत्त्वमिदं ज्ञेयं कपिरूपं व्यवस्थितम्॥ प्रयत्नं महदास्थाय क्रियतामस्य निग्रहः।
en: Therefore you should know him as some great being staying in the form of a monkey. Exerting yourself to the uttermost, do you chastise him.

sa: यथैव मां वनं यान्तमनुयाति महाद्युतिः। अहमप्यनुयास्यामि तथैवैनं यमक्षयम्॥
en: As this highly effulgent one had followed me into the forest, so will I in the same way follow him to the abode of Yama.

sa: राक्षसैर्वध्यमानानां वानराणां महाचमूः। शरण्यं शरणं याता रामं दशरथात्मजम्॥
en: Being thus assailed by the Räkşasas, the mighty host of monkeys took refuge of Răma, the son of Dasaratha, the worthy refuge of all creatures.

sa: स तस्य गतिमन्विच्छन्राजपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। दिदेशातिबलो रामो दश वानरयूथपान्॥
en: Then, anxious to ascertain his* course, the king's son possessed of prowess, and endowed with exceeding strength, Rāma, ordered ten of the monkey-leaders. * Indrajit's.

sa: भूयस्तु मम विज्ञाप्यं तच्छृणुष्व महाप्रभो। त्वय्यकारणसंतप्ते संतप्तहृदया वयम्॥
en: Further, O mighty master, listen to what I have to say. On your having been causelessly aggrieve, we all of us were seized with grief.

sa: दक्षिणं मण्डलं चोभौ सूतूर्णं संपरीयतुः। अन्योन्यमभिसंक्रुद्धौ जये प्रणिहितावुभौ॥
en: The both of them enraged with each other and anxious to score success, moving in circle on each other's right side, addressed themselves for action.

sa: मया तु हितकामेन यशश्च परिरक्षता। स्नेहप्रसन्नमनसा हितमित्यप्रियं कृतम्॥
en: And studious of your welfare, I have saved your fame; and with a mind overflowing with affection I have done (to you) this unpalatable good.

sa: राक्षसानां सहस्राणि निहत्य मधुसूदनः। वारिजं पूरयामास तोयदं सुरराडिव॥
en: Then, having despatched thousands of Rākşasas, the destroyer of Madhu blew his water-sprung (conch), even as the sovereign of the celestials filleth clouds (with rain).

sa: तत्राहं सर्वरात्रं तु विचरञ्जनकात्मजाम्। रावणान्त:पुरगतो न चापश्यं सुमध्यमाम्॥ ततः सीतामपश्यंस्तु रावणस्य निवेशने। शोकसागरमासाद्य न पारमुपलक्षये।।५३ ।
en: There I wandered all the night (seeking for Janaka's daughter) and (at length) entered Rāvana's inner apartment; but that one of a Deity waist I found not. And not finding Sītā in Ravana's abode, I was cast in a sea of sorrow; nor found I how to cross over it.

sa: व्रणानि परगात्रेभ्यो विष्णुचक्रकृतानि हि। असृक्क्षरन्ति धाराभिः स्वर्णधारा इवाचलाः॥
en: The wounds on the persons of the foes inflicted by the discus of Vişnu discharge blood in streams, like mountains discharging streams of red chalk.

sa: बहूनि वानरेन्द्राणामेष यूथानि वीर्यवान्। परिगृह्याभियाति त्वां स्वेनानीकेन मर्दितुम्॥
en: That powerful (hero) is proceeding, taking innumerable bands belonging to the lord of monkeys, for the purpose of beating you by means of his soldiery.

sa: महानूपुरकेयूरैरपविद्धैर्महाधनैः। पानभाजनविक्षिप्तैः फलैश्च विविधैरपि॥ कृतपुष्पोपहारा भूरधिकां पुष्यति श्रियम्।
en: With large and costly stray bangles and bracelests; and scattered cans, and diverse kinds of fruit; and wreaths of flowers, the pavement attained exceeding beauty.

sa: एवमेतत्पुरावृतं वालिना रावणः प्रभो। धर्षितश्च वृतश्चापि भ्राता पावकसंनिधौ॥
en: O lord Răma, I have thus related to you the previous history. Having thus belaboured Rāvaņa Vālī at last made friends with him before fire.

sa: आगच्छ राक्षसश्रेष्ठ वाक्यं शृणु मयोदितम्। यत्त्वया चोद्यतं वीर कुण्डलं मणिभूषितम्॥ एतद्धि पूर्वजस्यासीत्कर्णाभरणमीक्ष्यताम्। एतत्पतितवचैवमत्र भूमौ महाबल॥ अन्यत्पर्वतसानौ हि पतितं कुण्डलादनु। मुकुटं वेदिसामीप्ये पतितं युध्यतो भुवि॥
en: "Do you come, O foremost of Raksasas and hear my words. O hero, the kundala, crested with jewels, which you did assay to take up, is an ornament for the ear of one my forefathers. This fell here on the ground, O you gifted with great strength; another kundala was thrown on the summit of the mountain. Besides these kundalas his crown was also cast off on the ground before the altar during the encounter.

sa: जघ्ने ताराक्षसान्सर्वान्धृष्टो वायुसुतो रणे। क्रोधेन द्विगुणाविष्टः संवर्तक इवानलः॥
en: Then in the conflict the proud Wind-god's son, influenced by twofold wrath, spread havoc among the Rākşasa ranks, like the Fire at the universal dissolution.

sa: नापराध्यन्ति मे कामं वानरा वनचारिणः। जातिरस्मद्विधानां सा पुरोद्यानविभूषणम्॥
en: But the wood-ranging monkeys have not transgressed anywise to the like of us. That species is the ornament of the gardens attached to our residences.

sa: विभ्रमाच्चित्तमोहाद्वा बलवीर्याश्रयेण वा। नाभिपन्नमिदानीं यद्वयर्था तस्य पुनः कथा॥
en: Vain is the mention now of what I did either through stupor or delusion or pride of prowess. Now bethink you of what is proper.

sa: राक्षसीनां वचः श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। चिताग्निरिव जज्वाल कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः॥
en: Hearing the speeches of the Rākṣasīs, Rāvaņa, lord of Raksasas, with his eyes rolling in rage, flamed up like the fire of a funeral pyre.

sa: मृत्युं चतुर्भिर्विशिखैः सूतं सप्तभिरार्दयत्। यमं शतसहस्रेण शीघ्रं मर्मस्वताडयत्॥
en: And he smote Death with four, the (Yama's), charioteer with seven, and swiftly struck Yama in the marrow with hundreds and thousands of shafts. :

sa: एवमप्यतिनिद्रस्तु यदा नैव प्रबुध्यत। शापस्य वशमापनस्ततः कुद्धा निशाचराः॥
en: And coming under the sway of the curse, when that one sunk in slumber did not wake up, the night-rangers were wrought up with wrath.

sa: शीघ्रं व्यादिश नो राजन्वधायैषां दुरात्मनाम्। निपतन्ति हता यावद्धरण्यामल्पचेतनाः॥
en: Do you order us, O king, to destroy these vicious-souled demons. These shall crush them to death, limited as is the tenure of their life.

sa: अहमिन्द्रं वधिष्यामि धनदं वरुणं यमम्। त्रिदशान्विनिहत्याशु स्वयं स्थास्याम्यथोपरि॥
en: I shall slay Indra, Kubera, Varuna and Yama, what to speak of more, I shall soon destroy all the deities and place myself above them.

sa: नानाप्रहरणैर्व्यग्रैर्भुजैर्विस्मितबुद्धयः। तस्थुः प्रेक्ष्य च सर्वं ते नाभिजग्मुः परस्परम्॥
en: With various weapons and hands uplifted for fight, they, greatly wondered, stood there beholding them and did not address themselves to fight with each other.

sa: निराकृतश्च बहुशस्त्वयाह राक्षसाधिप। सापराधोऽपि बालो हि रक्षितव्यः स्वबान्धवैः।।२०
en: I have been utterly disregarded by you; but even if a boy should transgress, he should, for all that be protected by his family members.

sa: अहमस्य प्रदास्यामिपरमं वरमद्भुतम्। इतः प्रभृति वज्रस्य ममावध्यो भविष्यति॥
en: I will offer him a unique boon. He will not be killed hereafter with the help of my Vajra (or a weapon made of thunderbolt).

sa: अद्य नैर्ऋतकन्यानां श्रोष्याम्यन्तःपुरे रवम्। करेणुसङ्घस्य यथा निनादं गिरिगह्वरे॥
en: To-day shall I hear the cries of the daughters of the Naiſtas in my inner apartment, like to the roars of she-elephants in a mountain-cavern.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणं संरब्धं कुम्भकर्णमरिंदमम्। यूपाक्षः सचिवो राज्ञः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत॥
en: Thereat a minister of the king, named Yupakş a, with joined hands said to that humbler of foesKumbhakarna-wrought up with wrath, who was thus speaking.

sa: सपदि हरिवरस्ततो हनूमान् प्रतिवचनं जनकेश्वरात्मजायाः। कथितमकथयद्यकथाक्रमेण त्रिदशवरप्रतिमाय राघवाय॥
en: Thereupon Hanumān, the foremost of monkeys, related duly all what did the daughter of king Janaka say to Räghava resembling the lord of the celestials.

sa: नाज्ञापयितुमीशोऽहं युवराजोऽस्मि यद्यपि। अयुक्तं कृतकर्माणो यूयं धर्षयितुं बलात्॥
en: I am not justified to command although I am a prince. You are all of accomplished actions, it is not proper to repress you forcibly.

sa: रावणोऽपि ततः क्रुद्धो रथस्थो राक्षसेश्वरः। गदामुसलवर्षेण रामं प्रत्यर्दयद्रणे॥
en: Thereupon Rāvana too, the lord of Rākṣasas seated in car and highly enraged, assailed Răma in the conflict with a downpour of maces and Musalas.

sa: कल्प्यन्ते मत्तमातङ्गा युज्यन्ते रथवाजिनः। दृश्यन्ते तुरगारूढाः प्रासहस्ताः सहस्रशः॥
en: The mad elephants are caparisoned and the car-horses are yoked; and thousands of warriors) are seen, mounted on steeds, with bearded darts in their hands.

sa: शक्तौ तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ॥ सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षों किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः।
en: Those two best of men, gifted with the effulgence of Wind and Fire, and incapable of being repressed even by the celestials, are disregarding me.

sa: अश्विपुत्रौ महावेगावेतौ प्लवगसत्तमौ। एतयोः प्रतियोद्धारं न पश्यामि रणाजिरे॥
en: I do not find any one who can oppose in the battle field the two best monkeys, the sons of Asvi gifted with great velocity.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा परमप्रीतो रामो धर्मभृतां वरः॥ विभीषणमुवाचेदं वाक्यज्ञं वाक्यकोविदः।
en: Hearing those words, Rāma, the foremost of the pious and conversant with the skill of speech greatly delighted, spoke to Vibhisana (equally) skilled in speech.

sa: नहि तद्विद्यते कर्म सुहृदो हितकामिणः। रिपूणां सदृशं त्वेतद्यत्त्वयैतदनुष्ठितम्॥
en: The act that you have done, does not appear as that of a friend seeking our welfare; but today you have acted like an enemy.

sa: दृष्ट्वा देवास्तु तद्रक्षो वरदानेन दुर्जयम्। तिर्यग्योनि समाविष्टास्तस्य धर्षणभीरवः॥
en: Seeing that Rākşasa invincible by reason of the boon he had received, the deities, apprehensive of being worsted by him, assumed the forms of beasts.

sa: देव्या दिव्यप्रभावेण दग्धं सव्यं ममेक्षणम्। रेणुध्वस्तमिव ज्योतिः पिङ्गलत्वमुपागतम्॥
en: Thereupon through the divine energy of the goddess my left eye was burnt and seemed to be covered with dust, and its lustre became tawny.

sa: बद्धौ तु शरबन्धेन तावुभौ रणमूर्धनि। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण न शेकतुरवेक्षितुम्॥
en: And fast bound by the shackles of shafts on the edge of battle, they* could not attain respite for a moment, *i.e. Rama and Laksmana.

sa: निहतानाममात्यानां रुद्धस्य नगरस्य च। दुःखमेवापनेष्यामि हत्वा तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: All my courtiers have been slain and my city is shut up-I shall remove my grief consequent on all these by slaying Răma and Lakşmaņa.

sa: ततो रोषपरीताङ्गौ नदन्तावभ्यधावताम्। उद्यतासी रणे हृष्टौ युद्धे शस्त्रविशारदौ॥
en: Then uplifting them (those two heroes) with their persons trembling in ire, proficient in fighting and skilled in the use of weapons dashed on roaring.

sa: विभीषणमुखं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवं तांश्च वानरान्। लक्ष्मणोवाच मन्दार्थमिदं वाष्पपरिप्लुतः॥
en: Thereat, gazing at Vibhisana's countenance as well as all those monkeys, Laksmana, with his eyes flooded with tears, said these words pregnant with dire import.

sa: ततः समुद्रमासाद्य नलं सेतुमकारयत्। अतरत्कपिवीराणां वाहिनी तेन सेतुना॥
en: Thereupon arriving at the banks of the ocean he had a bridge constructed by Nala by which the army of monkey heroes crossed (the deep).

sa: मत्कृते विप्रयुक्ता ये पुत्रैदारैश्च वानराः। तान्प्रीतमनसः सर्वान्द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मानद॥
en: O you the conferror of honour, I wish to see all those delighted monkeys, who were separated from their wives and children on my account.

sa: आधिराज्येऽभिषेको मे ब्राह्मणैः पतिना सह। कृतान्तकुशलैरुक्तं तत्सर्वं वितथीकृतम्॥१४॥
en: Those Brähmaņas skilled in telling fortune said that I should be installed in the kingdom along with my husband; but all that has been falsified.

sa: ततो नारायणेनोक्ता देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः। सुरारीस्तान्हनिष्यामि सुरा भवत निर्भयाः॥
en: Then Nārāyana spoke to the celestials with Indra at their head, I will slay those foes of the celestials. You gods, cast off all fear!

sa: एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रषिराजगाम स्वमाश्रमम्। तपश्चचार सुमहत्सा पत्नी ब्रह्मवादिनः॥
en: Having said this that ascetic returned to his hermitage. And thenceforward the wife, of that ascetic chanting the themes of Brāhmaṇa, engaged in austere penances.

sa: तस्मै दृढधनुः क्रुद्धो हताश्वाय विभीषणः। वज्रस्पर्शसमान्पञ्च सस।रसि मार्गणान्॥
en: And Vibhîşana of a tough bow, growing enraged, discharged at (Indrajit), who had his steeds slain, five speeding shafts having the touch of the thunder-bolt.

sa: दृष्टो दोषो हि योऽस्माभिः पुरा मन्त्रविनिर्णये। हितेष्वनभियुक्तेन सोऽयमासादितस्त्वया॥
en: That evil which on the occasion of the conclave we had seen, has befallen you, who have passed by what was fraught with your good.

sa: शरधारास्ततो रामो रावणस्य धनुश्च्युताः। दृष्ट्वैवापतिताः शीघ्रं भल्लाञ्जग्राह सत्वरम्॥
en: Thereupon beholding the arrows shot off Ravana's bow fall on all sides, Rāma speedily took up a Bhalla.* *An arrow with a crescent shaped head.

sa: पृष्ठतो न व्रजध्वं मामग्रतो यान्तमाहवे। शूरैरभिजनोपैतेरयुक्तं हि निवर्तितुम्॥
en: Do you remain behind me, I shall go first in the battle. It is improper for heroes of noble descent to escape from battle field.

sa: कुर्वन्तस्ते महावेगा महीं चरणपीडिताम्। रजश्च सहसैवोर्ध्वं जगाम चरणोत्थितम्॥
en: They, endowed with great impetuosity, went on, oppressing the earth with their battle-array; and clouds of dust suddenly arose from the march of the soldiery.

sa: तैश्च दत्तवरः श्रीमानृषिभिश्च समागतैः। सुरर्षिभिश्च काकुत्स्थो वरॉल्लेभे परंतपः॥
en: That graceful descendant of Kākutstha, the slayer of foes, obtained the boon from them as well as from the saints assembled there (celestial and otherwise).

sa: काममार्य सुपर्याप्तो वधायास्य दुरात्मनः। विधमिष्याम्यहं चैतमनुजानीहि मां विभो॥
en: O noble one, I alone am fit to compass the destruction of this wicked-minded one. I will slay him. Do you, O master, permit me.

sa: द्रोणश्च विवरं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनं शिलीमुखैः। विव्याध बाणैर्निशितैः पञ्चषष्टिभिरायसैः॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, Drona availing himself of an weakness of Bhima pierced the latter with eight keen pointed dares whetted on stone.

sa: अभ्यधावत तेजस्वी भारद्वाजात्मजस्त्वरन्। निजघान च संक्रुद्धो राक्षसान् भीमदर्शनान्॥
en: The highly puissant son of Bharadvaja, without the least delay rushed against the former and excited with wrath he slew many Rakshasas of dreadful visage,

sa: तूष्णीमासीत् तदा देवः प्रजानामीश्वरेश्वरः। प्रसादं चागमत् क्षिप्रमात्मनैव प्रजापतिः॥
en: Then that Divinity, the Lord of the lords of creatures also remained silent for a while; and the grandsire soon became satisfied with his ownself.

sa: अन्योन्यं समपश्यन्त निकृत्ता मेदिनीतले। विचेष्टमानाः कृपणाः शोणितेन परिप्लुताः॥
en: They (your warriors) saw one another mangled and lying on the surface of the battle field, writhing in convulsions, distressed and weltering their own blood.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच शुचिर्भूत्वा महाबाहो संग्रामाभिमुखे स्थितः। पराजयाय शत्रूणां दुर्गास्तोत्रमुदीरय॥
en: The Deity said “O mighty-armed hero, purifying yourself, utter, on the even of battle, the hymn to Durga, so that you may defeat the foe".

sa: तथा देवाः सगन्धर्वाः पितरच जनाधिप। सिद्धचारणसंघाश्च समीयुस्ते दिदृक्षया॥
en: O ruler of men, then there came the celestial, the Gandharvas, the Pitris, the Siddhas and the Charanas with the desire of witnessing (the battle).

sa: उपसंहरतस्तस्य तमग्निं रोषजं तथा। प्रादुर्वभूव विश्वेभ्यो गोभ्यो नारी महात्मनः॥ कृष्णरक्ता तथा पिङ्गरक्तजिह्वास्यलोचना। कुण्डलाभ्यां च राजेन्द्र तप्ताभ्यां तप्तभूषणा॥
en: When that high-souled god had thus extinguished that fire of his wrath, there came out from the various outlets of his senseorgans, a female figure. She was dark and red and tawny and her tongue, countenance and eyes were red and she was adorned with two shining ear-rings and various other brilliant ornaments.

sa: सोपचारस्तु कृष्णश्च दुःखितां भृशदुःखितः। सिक्त्वांभसा समाश्वास्य तत्तदुक्त्वा हितं वचः॥ विसंज्ञकल्पां रुदती मर्मविद्धां प्रवेपतीम्। भगिनीं पुण्डरीकाक्ष इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then the highly-afflicted Krishna who was there ready with water sprinkled water on the face of them and for comforting them said such salutary words that should be said on such occasions. Then the eyes of resembling lotuspetals said these words to his sister, weeping, insensible, trembling and pierced in her very heart.

sa: वैष्णवं नकुलायाथ सहदेवाय चाश्विजम्। घटोत्कचाय पौलस्त्यं धनुर्दिव्यं भयानकम्॥
en: The Vaishnava bow was wielded by Nakula and the bow Ashvina by Sahadeva; the Paulastya of terrible appearance and celestial make, was held by Ghatotkacha.

sa: गाङ्गेयं भरतश्रेष्ठं दक्षिणेन च भास्करम्॥ इतरेतरमामन्त्र्य प्राहुस्तत्र मनीषिणः।
en: That foremost of the Bharatas, that son of Ganga, the sages, knowing the sun to be then in the Southern solstice addressing one another said

sa: दधार सुमहद् रूपमनन्त इव भोगवान्। ततो बहुविधैर्नागेश्छादयामास राक्षसम्॥
en: That Naga, assumed a prodigious form mighty like that of Ananta himself. Thereafter with those innumerable and diverse kinds of Nagas, he covered the Rakshasa.

sa: यमाहुरध्यर्धगुणं कृष्णात् पार्थाच्च संयुगे। अभिमन्यु पिशङ्गास्तं कुमारमवहन् रणे॥
en: Tawny-coloured steeds bore in battle prince Abhimanyu, who is said to be one and a half time superior in battle to both Krishna and Partha.

sa: तव प्रसादाद् गोविन्द पाण्डवा निहतद्विषः। स्वराज्यमनुसम्प्राप्ता मोदिष्यन्ते सबान्धवा॥
en: 0 Govinda, through your grace the Pandavas will recover their kingdom when their enemies will be killed and they will be happy with their kinsmen.

sa: एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच स्मयमानो जनार्दनः। तवैवैतद् युक्तरूपं वचनं पार्थिवोत्तम॥
en: Thus spoken to Janardana smilingly replied. “Indeed, O foremost of all the rulers of earth, these are words suited to fall from your lips only."

sa: दैवतानि च सर्वाणि पूज्यन्तां भूरिदक्षिणम्। अग्नयश्चापि हूयन्तां दाशार्णप्रतिषेधने॥
en: Pay worship also to all the gods with large presents (to the Brahmanas) and let the sacred fires be ablaze, to pacify the Dasharna king.

sa: मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रितं सार्धं त्वया पृथुललोचना पुरस्यास्याविनाशाय यच्च राजंस्तथा कुरु॥
en: Do as you had been counseled when you consulted with your ministers, O you with large eyes, for the preservation of this city, O king.

sa: क्षुप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन पार्थकेतुमताडयत्। ततोऽर्जुनो नवत्या तु शराणां तनपर्वणाम्॥
en: And again with a sharp razor-headed arrow, he struck the standard of Pritha's son. Then with a group of ninety shafts of depressed knots Arjuna.

sa: कुण्डलोष्णीषधारीणि जातरूपोज्ज्वलानि च। पतितानि स्म दृश्यन्ते शिरांसि भरतर्षभ॥
en: Many heads, O foremost of the Bharatas, were seen lying on the field of battle, graced with ear-rings and head-gears, and effulgent like gold itself.

sa: ततः शब्दो महानासीत् सैन्ययोरुभयोर्नृप। निर्गच्छमानयोः संख्ये सागरप्रतिमो महान्॥
en: Then a tremendous din was created by those two hosts when they marched out for battle, did that resembled the uproar of the ocean itself.

sa: कुनृपस्य यथा राष्टं दुर्भिक्षव्याधितस्करैः। द्राव्यते तद्वदापन्ना पाण्डवैस्तव वाहिनी॥
en: Just as the dominions of a wicked monarch are devasted by famine, pestilence and marauders, were your Own troops slaughtered and destroyed by the Pandavas.

sa: भीष्मं कुरूणामृषभं दिव्यकर्मपराक्रमम्। कर्मणा तेन पार्थस्य शक्रस्येव विकुर्वतः॥
en: That foremost of the Kurus, viz., Bhishma of god-like achievements and prowess. Then seeing that feat of Pritha son, that resembled that of Indra himself,

sa: बहुप्रकारान् सुस्वादून् भक्ष्यभोज्यान्नपर्वतान्। अतिरिक्तं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो भुञ्जानो हीयते जनः॥
en: Piles of delicate and tasteful foods and edibles, after the Brahmanas had been entertained, were partaken of by other people and greatly enhanced their joy.

sa: सकुण्डलं समुकुटं पद्मेन्दुसदृशप्रभम्। इरावत: शिरो रक्षः पातयामास भूतले॥
en: Then that Rakshasa felled on the earth the head of Iravat graced with earrings and a diadem, and effulgent like the moon or the lotus.

sa: ततस्तौ तत् सरो गत्वा सूर्यमण्डलसंनिभम्। नागमन्तर्जले घोरं ददृशातेऽर्जुनाच्युतौ॥
en: Thereafter Arjuna and the undeteriorating Krishna having repaired to that lake of the effulgence of the solar disc, saw in its waters a terrible serpent.

sa: खङ्गेनान्यांश्च चिच्छेद नादेनान्यांश्च भीषयन्। उरुवेगेन चाप्यन्यान् पातयामास भूतले॥
en: Others he cut down with his sword, others again he frightened with his terrible roars. Others he threw down by the force of his thighs.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् देवो यक्षराजः सुपूजितः। प्रययौ सहितः सर्वैनिमेषान्तरचारिभिः॥
en: Having thus spoken, that mighty god, king of the Yakshas, departed well honored, with all those followers, who traveled (a great distance) in a moment.

sa: पुनश्चैनं शरै।रैश्छादयामास भारत। निदाघान्ते महाराज यथा मेघो दिवाकरम्॥
en: One more he covered Satyaki with a dreadful group of arrows, O monarch, like clouds covering the sun at the expiration of the summer season.

sa: तमापतन्तं महता जवेन शिखण्डिनं भीष्ममभिद्रवन्तम्। मस्त्रेण घोरेण सुदुर्जयेन॥
en: When Shikhandin had been thus advancing with great momentum to fall upon Bhishma, Shalya checked him with a weapon dreadful and difficult of being baffled.

sa: तेजोवधानिमित्तं तु परुषं त्वाहमब्रुवम्। अक्समात् पाण्डवान् सर्वानवाक्षिपसि सुब्रत।॥
en: I used to apply words to you only for reducing your prowess. O you of excellent vows, you abuse the Pandavas without any reason whatsoever.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः सृक्किणी परिसंलिहन्। शक्तिं कनकवैदूर्यभूषितामायसीं दृढाम्॥ यमदण्डोपमा घोरां चिक्षेप परमाहवे। तामांपतन्ती सहसा तस्य बाहुबलेरिताम्॥ सात्यकिः समरे राजन् द्विधाचिच्छेद सायकैः। ततः पपात सहसा महोल्केव हतप्रभा॥
en: Thus deeply pierced, that mighty bow man, licking the corners of his mouth, hurled at Satyaki an iron lance decked with gold and lapises, of great toughness, and terrible like the mace of Death. Then Satyaki with his arrows cut off that lance, O king, that had been coursing swiftly towards him, being shot by the force of Bhagadatta's arm. Then that lance fell down with force on the ground like a large meteor shorn of its splendour.

sa: उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्। ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्॥
en: Know me to be Uchaishrava among all horses, produced by the churning for ambrosia, and Airavata among the great elephants. I am king among men.

sa: भूरिश्रवास्तु समरे धृष्टकेतुं महारथम्। हतसूतहयं चक्रे विरथं सायकोत्तमैः॥
en: Then in that conflict, Bhurishravas deprived the mighty car-warrior Dhrishtaketu (of the use) of his chariot, having slain its steeds and driver with excellent arrows.

sa: अजावय इवागोपा वने श्वापदसंकुले। भृशमुद्विग्नमनसो हीना देवव्रतेन ते॥
en: Like a herd of goats without a herdsman in wood infested with beasts of prey, they were exceedingly oppressed with fear, being deprived of Devavrata.

sa: तयोस्तदभवद् युद्धं घोररूपं विशाम्पते। दृप्तयोः समरे पूर्वं वृत्रवासवयोरिव।॥
en: O king, the battle that was fought between these two proud heroes soon became as fearful as the battle between the celestial and the Asuras.

sa: पूर्णायतविसृष्टेन क्षुरेण निशितेन च। ध्वजमेकेन चिच्छेद भीमसेनस्य पत्रिणा॥
en: With one winged arrow as sharp as a razor shot from his bow drawn to its fullest stretch, he cut off the standard of Bhimasena.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नो महेष्वासः सेनापतिपतिस्ततः। विधिवद् व्यूह्य मेधावी युद्धाय धृतमानसः॥
en: The great bowman, Dhrishtadyumna, the general of the commander of the army, endued with intelligence, having prepared his troops, duly waited patiently for the battle.

sa: अहं तु तान् कुरुवृषभानजिह्मगैः प्रवेशयन् यमसदनं चरन् रणे। यशः परं जगति विभाव्य वर्तिता परैर्हतो भुवि शयिताऽथवा पुनः॥
en: Coursing (swiftly) in the battle-field, I shall send, by means of my straight-going shafts, to the abode of Death, the foremost descendants of Kuru's race (Pandavas). Considering fame to be the best of all worldly possessions, I shall kill them in the engagement or myself lie on the field being slain by them.

sa: स कक्षेऽग्निरिवोत्सृष्टो निर्दहंस्तरसा रिपून्। मध्ये भारतसैन्यानामा निः पर्यवर्तत॥
en: Then like fire set to work on a heap of dried grass, consuming the hostile ranks, Arjuna's son moved in circles amidst the Kaurava hou.

sa: पितृपैतामहं कर्म कुर्वाणमतिमानुषम्। दृष्टवादितं शरैः काणिं त्वदीया हृषिताऽभवन्॥
en: Then beholding Abhimanyu, who had been achieving superhuman feats after the manner of his father and grandfather, afflicted with those shafts, your warriors became enraptured.

sa: यथा प्रागुदयात् सर्वेयुक्तास्तिष्ठन्त्यनीकिनः॥ ततः कर्णसमादिष्टा दूताः संत्वरिता रथैः।
en: So that all might be at the head of their respective divisions before sun rise. Then did messengers instructed by Karna, mount on cars speedily.

sa: अर्जुनस्य समादेशं यथोक्तं सर्वमब्रवीत्। वासुदेवस्य भीमस्य धर्मराजस्य पौरुषम्॥
en: Told him all he had been instructed to say by Arjuna as also the manly speeches of Vasudeva, of Bhima and of the virtuous king,

sa: ततोऽन्ये शतशः पश्चात् सहस्रायुतशो नराः। नर्दन्तः प्रययुस्तेषामनीकानि सहस्रशः॥
en: And above these, other men, by hundreds and thousands and tens of thousands of groups o thousands, followed their (sons of Pandu) forces, roaring loudly.

sa: तत्र भेरीसहस्राणि शङ्खानामयुतानि च। न्यवादयन्त संहृष्टाः सहस्रायुतशो नराः॥
en: And those men by thousands and tens of thousand, filled with joy, beat their drums by thousands, and blew their conches by tens of thousands.

sa: श्रुतकर्मा ततः क्रुद्धः काम्बोजानां महारथम्। शरैर्बहुभिरानछेद् दारयन्निव सर्वशः॥
en: Thereupon Shrutakarma in great anger weakened that great car warrior of the Kambojas with countless arrows and mangled him in many parts of his body.

sa: नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः। मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्॥
en: Shrouded by the delusion of My inconceivable power, I am not manifest to all. This deluded world, knows not Me who am unborn and undecaying.

sa: अन्तर्धानं चामपात्रे दुग्धा पुण्यजनैर्विराट्। दोग्धा वैश्रवणस्तेषां वत्सश्चासीद् वृषध्वजः॥
en: The Rakshasas milking her, in a jar of unbaked Earth, obtained the power of disappearing at will. Their milker Vaishravana and Vrishadhvaja was their calf.

sa: हिमवदुर्गनिलयाः किराता रणकर्कशाः। दुर्योधनस्य वशगास्त्वया कर्ण पूरा कृताः॥
en: O Karna, in days gone by, you brought under the authority of Duryodhana the Kiratas obstinate in battle and peopling the strongholds of the Himavat.

sa: कामैस्तैस्तैर्हतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः। तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया।॥
en: Those, that are deprived of knowledge by desire, reach other gods (divinities), by observing various (religious) regulations, and by being uncontrolled by their own nature.

sa: अलम्बुषोऽसंक्रुद्धः कार्ष्णि नवभिराशुगैः। हृदि विव्याध वेगेन तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्॥
en: Thereupon Alambusha, inflamed with rage, pierced Krishna's nephew on the breast with nine swift-coursing shafts, like a guide piercing a huge elephant with the hook.

sa: अनतिक्रमणीयोऽयं कृतान्तस्याद्भुतो विधिः। मा शुचो भरतश्रेष्ठ दिष्टमेतत् पुरातनम्॥
en: The decrees of Destiny and wonderful and enevitable. O foremost of the Bharatas, do not give way to grief, for these things are not unique.

sa: तस्मिन्नसुकरं कर्म कृतवत्यास्थिते दिवम्। कंन सेनाप्रणेतारं मन्यसे तदनन्तरम्॥
en: When that onc, who accomplished many difficult acts, is gone to heaven, ( Karna, whom do you consider capable of leading this host into battle)?

sa: द्रोणेन विहितो व्यूहः पदात्यश्वरथद्विपैः॥ वातोद्धतार्णवाकारः प्रवृत्त इव लक्ष्यते।
en: That array formed by Drona and composed of foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants, appeared to dance like the ocean lashed into fury by the tempest.

sa: एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय। अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा॥
en: Know, that all things have these (Earth, Water &c.) for their source. I am the productive Cause and the destroying Agent of all the Universe.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ बाह्रीकः सह बाह्निकैः। त्रिगर्तराजो बलवान् मागधश्च सुदुर्जयः॥
en: And Vinda and Anuvinda of Avanti, and Balhika with the Balhikas, and the mighty king of the Trigartas and the formidable sovereign of the Magadhas,

sa: सेनाग्रादपि निष्पत्य प्रायुध्यस्तत्र मानवाः। उभयोः सेनयो राजन् व्यतिषक्तरथद्विपाः॥
en: O king, the cars and the elephants of both the armies and other combatants came out of their respective arrays and engaged in the fight.

sa: भूरिश्रवाश्च शल्यश्च द्रौणिः सांयमनि: शलः। नाभ्यवर्तन्त संरलब्धाः काणैर्बाहुबलोदयम्॥
en: Bhurishrava, Shalya, Drona's son, Samyamani and Shala were all seized with panic by seeing the prowess of Arjuna's son. They could not stay before him.

sa: प्रवर्तमाने संग्रामे तस्मिन्नतिभयंकरे। द्रोणस्य मिषतो व्यूह भित्त्वा प्राविशदार्जुनिः॥
en: When that awful conflict raged fiercely, the son of Arjuna breaking through the enemies' array entered it even before the very eyes of Drona himself.

sa: अभिमन्युरुवाच अहमेतत् प्रवेक्ष्यामि पतङ्ग इव संक्रुद्धो ज्वलितं जातवेदसम्॥
en: Abhimanyu said I will break through this invincible array of Drona, like an insect under the influence of anger entering into the flames. I so

sa: तदद्भुतमपश्याम द्रोणस्य भुजयोर्बलम्। यदेनं नाभ्यवर्तन्त पञ्चालाः सृञ्जयैः सह॥
en: Then we beheld the wonderful strength of Drona's arms, in as much as, the Panchalas aided by the Srinjayas was not able to assail him.

sa: यस्याहमधिरुह्याङ्कं बालः किल गदाग्रजा तातेत्यवोचं पितरं पितुः पाण्डोर्महात्मनः॥
en: O elder brother of Gada, in my childhood, climbing on the lap of the high-souled father of Pandu (our father), I used to say 'Father';

sa: तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धमापतन्तं यतव्रतम्। दृष्टा सम्प्राद्रवन् योधाः पाण्डवस्य ततस्ततः॥
en: Beholding that one of regulated vows rush at them like the god of Death enraged, all the warriors of the Pandavas sped on all directions.

sa: उत्कृत्य च शिरांस्युग्रान् बाहूनपि सुभूषणान्। कृत्वा शून्यान् रथोपस्थानुदक्रोशन्महारथान्॥
en: Severing down many heads as well as arms decorated with ornaments and rendering the seats of many a car empty, he sent up terrific roars.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे परिवार्य वृकोदरम्। भीष्ममभ्यद्रवन् क्रुद्धास्ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: So also, the Pandavas, surrounding Vrikodara and riding on fleet animals in that battle, rushed inflamed with wrath against the division led by Bhishma. cars,

sa: श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः। ज्ञानं लब्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति॥
en: The man of faith, the man of assiduousness, the man of self-restraint, obtains knowledge; and obtaining knowledge, he gains the highest tranquility (Mukti) without delay.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम हैडिम्बस्य पराक्रमम्। अतीत्य पितरं युद्धे यदयुध्यत भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the prowess that we saw displayed by the son of Hidimba was exceedingly wonderful; for he transcended even his father (Bhima).

sa: स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा विनिःश्वस्य मुहुर्मुहुः। संजय संशितात्मानमपृच्छद् भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Having reflected for a moment, he sighed again and again. O foremost of the Bharata race, the king then thus spoke to the selfcontrolled Sanjaya.

sa: न प्रहर्तुमीप्सामि गृहीतेषुः कथइन। तदन्तरं समासाद्य पाण्डवो धनंजयः८४॥
en: Beholding them an inauspicious man in the person of him who was female before, I will not strike though I may be armed with arrows.

sa: तान् निवृत्तान् समीक्ष्यैव ततोऽन्येऽपीतरे जनाः। अन्योन्यस्पर्धया राजल्लँज्जया चावतस्थिरे॥
en: O king, then the common soldiers having seen them stop, stopped of their own accord from shame and from the desire of displaying their prowess.

sa: सकुण्डलानां पततां शिरसां धरणीतले। पद्यानामिव संघातैः पार्थश्चके निवेदनम्॥
en: Those heads graced with ear-rings falling incessantly on the Earth, looked like so many lotuses that Pritha's son was culling, for an offering of "ods.

sa: संजातरुधिरोत्पीडः प्रेक्षणीयोऽभवद् रणे। गभस्तिभिरिवार्कस्य संस्यूतो जलदो महान्॥ संचोदितो मदस्रावी भगदत्तेन वारणः। अभ्यधावत तान् सर्वान् कालोत्सृष्ट इवान्तकः॥
en: And with blood spattered on its body became, in that battle, woryour of being looked at, like masses of rain-clouds tinged with the rays of the sun. That elephant, shedding temporal juice, being goaded by Bhagadatta, rushed against all those (heroes), like Death incarnate urged on by the Destroyer himself.

sa: तस्याहमग्रजः पुत्रः सर्वस्य जगतः प्रभुः। वासुदेवोऽर्चनीयो वः सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः॥
en: That Lord of the universe, whose son I Brahma am, that Vasudeva, the Paramount Lord of all the worlds should always be worshipped by you.

sa: केचिदेनकेन बाणेन सुयुक्तेन सुपत्रिणा। ह्रौ त्रयश्च विनिर्भिन्ना निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: Sometimes two or three warriors penetrated by a single arrow decked with beautiful feathers and heedfully shot from the Gandiva, fell down on the Earth.

sa: अपेतशिशिरे काले समिद्धमिव पावकम्। अत्यरोचत सौभद्रस्तव सैन्यानि नाशयन्॥
en: Like a blazing fire consuming a heap of fuel in the summer season. Thus smiting down your soldiers the son of Subhadra appeared highly beautiful.

sa: ततो वादित्रघोषाश्च प्रादुरासन् सहस्रशः। सिंहनादश्च पाण्डूनां प्रतिज्ञाते महात्मना॥
en: Then when the high-souled Arjuna had taken that oath, sounds of thousands of musical instruments and fierce war-cries, arose from the encampment of the Pandavas.

sa: तौ स्थात् सिंहसंकाशौ लोहिताक्षौ महाभुजौ। राजन् सम्पेततुर्वीरौ सोदर्यावेकलक्षणौ॥
en: Thereupon those two heroic brothers with red eyes, possessed on long arms, having similar features and looking like two lions, fell down from their car.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं द्वादशभिर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्। धृष्टद्युम्नं ततो विद्ध्वा ननाद सुमहाबलः॥ तं द्वादशाख्यैर्नकुलो माधवश्च त्रिभिः शरैः। धृष्टद्युम्नश्च सप्तत्या भीमसेनश्च सप्तभिः॥
en: Yudhishthira with twelve shafts on the arms and on the breast. Then that highly powerful hero, having pierced Dhrishtadyumna also, uttered a loud roar. Nakula pierced him in return with twelve shafts, the descendant of Madhu's race with three, Sahadeva with seventy, Partha with nine, Dhrishtadyumna with seventy and Bhimasena with seven shafts.

sa: तं चतुर्दशभिः पार्थो नाराचैः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। साश्वध्वजधनुः सूतं विव्याधाचिन्त्यविक्रमः॥
en: Then Partha of inconceivable prowess pierced Sudakshina and his steeds standards, bow and charioteer with ten narachas furnished with the feathers of the Kanka bird.

sa: तत्रास्य सुमहद् राजन् बाह्वोर्बलमदृश्यत्। यतमानस्य समरे भीष्ममर्दयतः शरैः॥
en: When he was thus struggling in the battle, and afflicting Bhishma with (his) arrows, the strength of his arms we saw then was very great.

sa: भग्नमाज्ञाय निस्त्रिंशमवप्लुत्य पदानि षट्। अदृश्यत निमेषेण स्वरथं पुनरास्थितः॥
en: Beholding his own sword break, Jayadratha receded six steps and within an wink of the eye, was seen to be mounted on his own car.

sa: हृतोत्तमाङ्गाः स्कन्धेषु गजानां गजयोधिनः। अदृश्यन्ताचलाचेषु दुमा भग्नशिखा इव॥
en: And elephants-riders deprived of heads, seated as they were on the necks of those beasts, appeared like ties on a mountain with their heads broken.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान् प्रत्युवाच पितामहः। देवब्रह्मर्षिगन्धर्वान् सर्वान् मधुरया गिरा॥
en: Thus spoken to, the almighty Grandsire, thus replied to the celestials, the regenerate sages, the Gandharvas and every one else in soft and sweet words.

sa: दाशार्णकाः प्रभद्राश्च दाशेरकगणैः सह॥ अनूपका: किराताश्च ग्रीवायां भरतर्षभ।
en: O best of the Bharata race, the ruler of the Dasharhas, the Prayagas, the Dasherakas, the Anupakas and the Kiratas were placed in its neck.

sa: भूयश्चैनं महाबाहुः शरैः शीघ्रमवाकिरत्। पर्वतं वारिधाराभिः प्रावृषीव बलाहकः॥
en: Then again that hero of mighty-arms speedily covered him with a shower of arrows, like clouds covering the mountains with rains in the rainy season.

sa: सेनयोरुभयोश्चापि समन्ताच्छूयते महान्। पाञ्चजन्यस्य निर्घोषो गाण्डीवस्य च निःस्वनः॥
en: A loud uproar set up by the two armies is heard, as also the blare of the conch Panchajanya, and the twang of bow Gandiva.

sa: एकैकं त्रिभिरानछेत् कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः। शरैरतिरथो युद्धे पीडयन् वाहिनीं तव॥
en: All these warriors were pierced each with three shafts winged with Kanka and peacock feathers, by the Atiratha Arjuna, who had been afflicting your army.

sa: संजय उवाच अथ वीरो महेष्वासो मत्तवारणविक्रमः। समादाय महच्चापं मत्तवारणवारणम्॥ विन्धुन्वानो नरश्रेष्ठो द्रावयाणो वरूथिनीम्। पृतनां पाण्डवेयानां गाहमानो महाबलः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then that foremost of men, the valiant Drona, that fierce bow-man possessed of the prowess of an infuriate elephants and of great energy taking up and shaking his bow capable of checking even an infuriate elephant, began to crush the arrayed lines of the Pandavas, having penetrated into their very midst.

sa: तानहं शरवर्षेण समन्तात् पर्यवारयम्। सर्वान् नृपांश्चाप्यजयं देवराडिव दानवान्॥
en: Then, with a shower of arrows I arrested their rush and vanquished all those rulers of the earth like of the gods vanquishing the Danavas.

sa: अभिद्यत ततो व्यूहस्तस्मिन् वीरसमागमे। सर्वेषामेव सैन्यानामासीद् व्यतिकरो महान्॥
en: The great (Pandava) Vyuha wavered at that great attack made by that (Kuru) hero. The battle that was then fought by the combatants was fearful.

sa: शास्त्राणां भरतश्रेष्ठः मनुष्याणां च गर्जताम्। सुमहानभवच्छब्दः प्रेतानामिव भारत॥
en: The clashing of weapons and the yells of men, O foremost of the Bharatas, created a fierce din, that resembled the roar of demons themselves.

sa: अभ्यस्तो बहुभिर्बाणैर्दशधर्मगतेन वै। शोचयत्येष नियत्तं भूयः पुत्रवधाद्धि माम्॥
en: Afflicted with various darts he has gone to the way of all creatures. I grieve more over his than on the slaughter of my son.

sa: निपेतुस्तुरगास्तस्य रथयुक्ता महाजवाः। समे पुष्पचिते देशे राजमार्गे यदृच्छया॥
en: The steeds yoked to his (Khara's) car, gifted with great celerity, dropped down all of a sudden on the level high ways strewn with blossoms.

sa: कुलीनार्यजनोपेतं तुष्टपुष्टमनुद्धतम्। कृतमानोपचारं च यशखि च मनखि च॥
en: They are high-born, respectable, evercontented, well-fed and submissive. They have been duly honoured and rewarded by ourselves. They are all endued with fame and intelligence.

sa: नकुलः सहदेवोऽहं धृष्टद्युम्नोऽहमित्युत। द्रौपदी द्रौपदेयाश्च इत्येवं ते विचुक्रुशुः॥
en: I am Nakula, I am Sahadeva! I am Dhrishtadyumna! I am Draupadi! We are the sons of Draupadi! thus O king did those voice speak.

sa: विमुक्तौ जनसम्बाधाच्छत्रुभिः परिवीक्षितौ। कृष्णयानुगतौ तत्र नृवीरौ तौ विरेजतुः॥ पौर्णमास्यां घनर्मुक्तौ चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ। तेषां माता बहुविधं विनाशं पर्यचिन्तयत्॥
en: Those heroes among men, mangled by the enemies and followed by Krishna, at last came out of the crowd and they looked like the full moon or the sun emerged from the clouds. And their mother (Kunti in her lodging) began to think of various evils having overtaken her sons.

sa: पठन्ति पाणिस्वनिका मागधा मधुपर्किकाः। वैतालिकाश्च सूताश्च तुष्टुवुः पुरुषर्षभम्॥
en: The Panisvanikas, the Magadhas, the Madhuparkikas began to read verses in his praise; and Vaitalikas and minstrels began to eulogise that foremost of men (Yudhishthira).

sa: तेषां चतुःशतान् वीरान् यतमानान् महारथान्। अर्जुनो निशितेर्बाणैरनयद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Among those great car-warriors four hundred valiantly kept the field; and Arjuna, with his keen shafts, sent them, one and all, to their last account.

sa: वृषसेनः कर्णसुतः शल्यो मद्राधिपस्तथा। द्रोणपुत्रश्च शैनेयं सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: (Then) Vrisasena, the son of Karna and Shalya, the king of Madra and the son of Drona surrounded the grandson of Sini on all sides.

sa: स्त्रीपुंसयोर्नरव्याघ्रो यः स वेद गुणागुणान्। शिखण्डिनं याज्ञसेनिमम्लानमनसं युधि॥ देवव्रतस्य समरे हेतुं मृत्योर्महात्मनः। द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं के शूराः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: What warriors of my army encountered Sikhandin when he rushed at Drona-Sikhandin, the foremost of mean, who has relised the pleasures (in himself) of man hood and femininity, that son of Yajnasena, who is ever cheerful in battle and who became the cause of the death of the high souled Devavrata in battle?

sa: तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं सौबलेयः प्रतापवान्॥ अन्यदादाय वेगेन धनुर्भल्लांश्च षोडश।
en: Whereupon the mighty son of Subala, throwing away that bow, rendered useless, with the greatest alacrity seized a new one, as also sixteen broad-edged shafts.

sa: तेषां चतुर्णा रामस्तु शिरांसि समरे शरैः। क्रुद्धश्चतुर्भिश्चिच्छेद घोरैरग्निशिखोपमैः॥
en: Thereat, Rāma, growing wroth, in battle severed the heads of those four by means of four shafts, dreadful, and resembling the tongues of a fame.

sa: इत्युक्तः स मुनिश्रेष्ठः पुनरेवाभ्यभाषत। रमयन् वृष्णिशार्दूलं पाण्डवांश्च महानृषिः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed, that great Rishi again began to narrate, delighting that foremost of the Vrishni race (Krishna) and the Pandavas.

sa: स निर्जित्यमहीं कृत्स्ना सशैलवनकाननाम्। आजहार महाराज राजसूयं महाक्रतुम्॥
en: O great king, having conquered the whole of the earth with her mountains, forests and woods, he made preparation to perform a great Rajasuya sacrifice.

sa: ते द्राव्यमाणाः समरे हार्दिक्येन महारथाः। विमुखाः समपद्यन्त शरवृष्टिभिरार्दिताः॥
en: Those mighty car-warriors routed by the son of Hridika, were compelled to turn their faces leack, afflicted as they were with incessant showers of arrows.

sa: ततः शुद्धान्तमासाद्य जानुभ्यां भूतले स्थितः। शिरसा वन्दनीयं तमभिवाद्य जनेश्वरम्॥ कुण्डली बद्धनिस्त्रिंशः संनद्धकवचो युवा। अभिप्रणम्य शिरसा द्वा:स्थो धर्मात्मजाय वै॥ न्यवेदयद्धृषीकेशमुपयान्तं महात्मने। सोऽब्रवीत् पुरुषव्याघ्रः स्वागतेनैव माधवम्॥
en: Then one of the attendants guarding the doors, cased in armour, youthful, adorned with ear-rings and having his sword tied to his waist-band, entered the private chamber of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira; then kneeling down before him and doing obeisance to the worshipful and illustrious monarch with his head, he represented that Hrishikesha was waiting to be ushered in. Thereupon that foremost of men (Yudhishthira) welcomed Madhava with inquiries after his health and welfare.

sa: ते हयाः सहसोत्पेतुर्गृहीत्वा स्यन्दनोत्तमम्। आस्थितं पाण्डवेयाभ्यां यदूनामृषभेण च॥
en: Those horses then suddenly ran taking after them that excellent vehicle ridden by the two sons of Pandu and by that foremost of Yadu's race.

sa: हाहाकृता द्विजाश्चैव भयार्ता वृषलार्दिताः। त्रातारमलभन्तो वै भ्रमिष्यन्ति महीमिमाम्॥
en: The Brahmanas, being persecuted by the Shudras and afflicted with fear and exclaiming "Oh" "Alas" will rove over the world with none to protect them.

sa: ते तस्य रूपमालोक्य यथा विष्णोस्त्रिविक्रमे। भयाद्वानरयोधास्ते विद्रवन्ति ततस्ततः।।।।।
en: Seeing his form like to that of Vişnu when he displayed his threefold energy, the monkeywarriors seized with fear, began to scour on all sides.

sa: आश्रमस्थं विना रामं जगदग्निमुपाद्रवन्। ते तं जघ्नुर्महावीर्यमयुध्यन्तं तपस्विनम्॥
en: Rushed at Jamadagni (one day, when Rama was absent from the hermitage. Although he was powerful they killed him for he was engaged in asceticism.

sa: जिघांसन्तः शतानीकं सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्। छाद्यमानं शरव्रातैः शतानीकं यशस्विनम्॥
en: encompassed Shatanika on all sides, out of a desire for slaying him; and they began to strike the illustrious Shatanika with a showers of arrows.

sa: गुरूणां वचनाच्छीघ्रं सम्भाराः सम्भ्रियन्तु मे। समर्थाधिष्ठितश्चाश्वः सोपाध्यायो विमुच्यताम्॥
en: In accordance with the directions of my spiritual guides, do you speedily procure these provisions, loose the horse well protected, and followed by a priest.

sa: भूरिस्तु समरे राजशैनेयं रथिनां वरम्। आपतन्तमपासेधत् प्रयाणादिव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Bhuri also, 0 monarch, in (that) engagement, checked the grandson of Sini who rushing along like elephant (descending) from a gradually sloping ground.

sa: ज्ञात्वैतच्छद्मना वली रक्षार्थं सव्यसाचिनः। कुण्डले कवचं चैव कर्णस्यापहरिष्यति॥
en: The wielder of thunder (Indra), knowing all this and desirous of saving Savyasachi (Arjuna), will in disguise take away from Karna his ear-rings and armour.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु कर्णेन दैत्यानां वचनात् तथा। प्रणिपातेन चाप्येषामुदतिष्ठत् सुयोधनः॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Karna and having (also) remembered the words of the Daityas and the supplications made by (his brothers), Duryodhana rose up.

sa: तव हनुमते भीष्म नियतं स महातपाः। विचित्रवीर्यक्षेत्रेषु पुत्रानुत्पादयिष्यति॥
en: O Bhishma if you are willing and if you appoint him, I am sure that great ascetic will beget children on the wives of Vichitravirya.

sa: कन्दरोदरसंस्थानां पीडितानां महौजसाम्। सिंहानां निनदो भीमो नभो भिन्दन् हि शुश्रुवे॥ त्रस्तव्याविद्धवसना व्याकुलीकृतभूषणाः। विद्याधर्यः समुत्पेतुः सहसा धरणीधरात्॥
en: The dreadful yells of mighty lions in pain, inhabiting caves, entered the car, piercing the heavens. And Vidyādharis with their attires falling off and their ornaments disordered, suddenly rose from the mountain to the sky. (Dharanidharāt-at-from the holder of the Earth, the latter being supposed to rest on a mountain)

sa: ततः प्रज्वलितैर्बाणैः सर्वतः सोपचीयते। उपचीयमानश्च मया महास्त्रेण व्यवर्धत।॥
en: He was then completely covered with flaming arrows (issuing from that weapon) and when thus covered with that mighty weapon his body began to expand.

sa: रेणुकां त्वथ सम्प्राप्य भार्यां भार्गवनन्दनः। आश्रमस्थस्तया सार्धं तपस्तेपेऽनुकूलया॥
en: Having got Renuka as his wife, that son of Bhrigu came with her to the hermitage; and assisted by her he began to practise asceticism.

sa: न चाद्भुतमिदं मन्ये यद द्रौणियुद्धसंज्ञया। घातयिष्यति कौरव्यान् परित्रातुमशक्नुवन्॥
en: There is nothing wonderful in the fact that Drona's son leading the Kauravas in battle, will cause their destruction, being himself unable to protect them.

sa: गावल्गणे कुरून् गत्वा धृतराष्ट्र महाबलम्। अभिवाद्योपसंगृह्य ततः पृच्छेरनामयम्॥
en: O son of Gavalgani, going to the Kauravas, you should great king Dhritarashtra of great strength hand touching his feet ask him regarding his health.

sa: संशप्तकाश्च मे वध्या द्रौणिराह्वयते च माम्॥ यदत्रानन्तरं प्राप्तं शंस मे तद्धि माधव। आतिथ्यकर्माभ्युत्थाय दीयतां यदि मन्यसे॥
en: The army of the Samasaptakas should be slaughtered by me; but, again, the son of Drona is inviting me to battle. O Madhava, do you order me really what should be performed first. If you consider it proper, that the work of hospitality should be given Ashvatthama first after rising.

sa: दृष्ट्वा सुकृपणां चेमामवस्थामात्मनो बले। ज्ञातिमित्रपरित्यक्तः शोचस्याहो न शोचसि॥
en: You are now, however, deserted by both kinsmen and friends. Beholding this miserable condition of yours, do you or do you not indulge in grief?

sa: सादिभिः स्यन्दनै गैरधिकं समलङ्कृतेः। स व्यूहराजो विबभौ देवासुरचमूपमः॥
en: Brilliantly adorned with cavalry, carwarriors and elephants that best of armies looked exceedingly picturesque like that of that of the gods or of the demons.

sa: अप्रकाशान्यप्रियाणि चकारास्य वृकोदरः। आज्ञा प्रत्यहरच्चापि कृतज्ञैः पुरुषैः सदा॥
en: Vrikodara secretly did many deeds that were disagreeable to the old king. Through deceitful servants he caused the commands of his uncle to be disobeyed.

sa: दत्त्वा तु सततं तेऽस्तु कौरवाणां धुरन्धर। दानयज्ञक्रियायुक्ता बुद्धिर्धर्मोपचायिनी॥
en: O foremost scion of Kuru's race, these men devoted their virtuous intellects to the celebration of sacrifices and charities by always performing acts of charity.

sa: विद्यामधीत्य तां राजस्त्वयोक्तामरिमर्दन। भवता च समादिष्टस्तपसे प्रस्थितो वनम्॥
en: O destroyer of foes, having studied that (branch of) learning as directed by you, I repaired to the forest at your command for practicing asceticism.

sa: ततः सेनामुखे कर्णं दृष्ट्वा राजा युधिष्ठिरः। धनंजयममित्रघ्नमेकवीरमुवाच ह॥
en: Beholding Karna at the head of the army Yudhishthira addressed the following words to Dhananjaya, that slayer of foes, the one heroes in the battle.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा धनुर्घोरं विकृष्योभ्राम्य चासकृत्। समाधत्त शरान् घोरान् महाशनिसमप्रभान्॥
en: Having spoken these words, and bending and repeatedly stretching his bow and taking up terrible arrows that resembled the thunder boit itself in effulgence Bhima.

sa: ततः पञ्चदशे वर्षे समतीते नराधिपः॥ राजा निर्वेदमापेदे भीमवाग्बाणपीडितः।
en: Then, after fifteen years had passed away, o monarch, king Dhritarashtra, afflicted (constantly) by the wordy arrows of Bhima, became stricken with despair and sorrow.

sa: अमर्षी नित्यसंरब्धश्चिर वैरमनुस्मरन्। एष भीमो जयेप्रेप्सुर्युधि तिष्ठति वीर्यवान्॥
en: With his anger always burning, bent on wrecking revenge the highly energetic Bhima stands there with a view to acquire victory, remembering all his wrongs.

sa: इति द्वैतवने तात मामुवाच धनंजयः। परोक्षे त्वद्गुणांस्तथ्यान् कथयन्नार्यसंसदि॥
en: This is what Dhananjaya said to me in your absence in the Dvaita forest while applauding your virtue's truly in an assembly of the righteous.

sa: एवमस्त्विति राजानमुक्त्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवः। अभ्ययात् त्वरितो भैमि सहितः पुरुषादकैः॥
en: "Then let it be so," replying thus to the king, that foremost of the Rakshasas, accompanied by his man-eating followers, dashed in fury against Bhimasena.

sa: अथास्य सहसाविध्यद्धयान् दशभिराशुगैः। दशभिर्दशभिः क्रुद्ध उभौ च पार्ष्णिसारथी॥
en: Then he suddenly pierced Drona's horses with ten swift-going-arrows. Thereafter wrought up with ire, he pierced the two Parshni-drivers of Drona with ten shafts each.

sa: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः। आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्॥
en: Being freed from these three gates of darkness, O son of Kunti, a man works out his own good. He then reaches the highest goal.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अर्जुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नकुलो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। राजानमभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य सर्वधर्मभृतां वरम्॥ अनुरुथ्य महाप्राज्ञो भ्रातुश्चित्तमरिन्दम। व्यूढोरस्को महाबाहुस्ताम्रास्यो मितभाषिता॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Hearing these words of Arjuna, O chastiser of foes, the mighty-armed and broad chested, Nakula, temperate in speech and possessed of great wisdom, with copper coloured face, looked at the king, that foremost of all righteous persons, and spoke the these words, assailing his brother's heart (with reason).

sa: यावत्सुरैश्च विप्रैश्च न विरुध्येर्महासुर। तावच्छूलं तवेदं स्यादन्यथा नाशमेष्यति॥
en: So long as you, O mighty Asura, do not assail celestials and Vipras, so long shall this be your, otherwise it shall come to naught.

sa: ब्रह्मण्यश्च शरण्यश्च बुद्ध्या च परिनिष्ठितः। सुरैश्च परमोदारैः प्रीतिस्तस्यातुलाभवत्॥
en: He was well disposed towards Brāhmaṇas, kind to those seeking his refuge, and gifted with high intelligence. The exceedingly generous deities delighted in him greatly.

sa: चिच्छेद बहुधा राजन् दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्॥ तं कर्णश्छादयामास शरवातैरनेकशः।
en: Cut them in numerous parts, displaying at the same time his great lightness of hands. Karna then shrouded him in a net-work of numerous arrows.

sa: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत्। वाहांश्च चतुरस्तस्य व्यंसूश्चक्रे महारथः॥
en: Then with a broad-headed shaft, Bhima dispatched Karna's charioteer to the abode of Death; then that mighty car-warrior deprived the latter's steeds of their lives.

sa: हितबुद्ध्या यदहितं वचः परुषमुच्यते। परपक्षं प्रविश्यैव नैतच्छ्रोक्षगतं मम॥
en: The words which, deeming the strength of the enemy as superior, you have harshly spoken, considering it as beneficial, had never before entered my ears.

sa: गत्वा कर्णरथाभ्याशं व्यचरत् कुण्डलाननः॥ प्राह वाक्यमसम्भ्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं विशाम्पते।
en: Then going near the vicinity of Karna's chariot, Ghatotkacha with his his ear-rings moving, dauntlessly addressed the son of Suta, O king, in these words.

sa: तेषामापततां शीघ्रं गाण्डीवप्रेषितैः शरैः। निचकर्त शिरांस्युग्रो बाहूनपि सुभूषणान्॥
en: But with the arrows shot from his Gandiva bow, Aruna quickly cut-off their heads and arms decked with ornaments, as they were rushing against him.

sa: मन्त्रसंवरणे यत्नः सदा कार्योऽनसूयता। आकारमभिरक्षेत चारेणाप्यनुपालितः॥ नाच्छित्त्वा परमर्माणि नाकृत्वा कर्म दारुणम्। नाहत्वा मत्स्यघातीव प्राणोति महतीं श्रियम्॥
en: And while seeing everything with the eyes of his spies, he should conceit his own thoughts before the spies of others like a fisherman who becomes rich by catching and killing fish, a king grc" vs prosperous by tearing the vitals of his enemy and by doing some violent acts.

sa: स शरैः समवच्छन्नश्चकाशे पाण्डवर्षभः। पञ्जरान्तरसंचारी शकुन्त इव भारत॥
en: That foremost son of Pandu, in the midst of that cloud of arrows, resembled a bird in the midst of an iron cage, O Bharata.

sa: बलिनो स्पर्धिनौ वीरो कुलजौ बाहुशालिनौ। तावेनं शरवर्षाणि सव्यदक्षिणमस्यताम्॥
en: Those two heroes endued with prowess, pride and strength of arms and both born in noble families, began to scatter their arrows right and left.

sa: उत्तमं ह्याददानस्य धनुरस्याशुकारिणः। ज्याघोषो निघ्नतोऽमित्रान् दिक्षु सर्वासु शुश्रुवे॥
en: The twang of the bowstring of that one of great activity was heard in all directions when he stretched his bow to slay his enemies.

sa: मां हि सा मृगशावाक्षी चिन्ताशोकबलात्कृतम्॥ संतापयति सौमित्रे क्रूरश्चैत्रवनानिलः।
en: That one having the eyes of a fawn and ruthless vernal breeze, O Saumitri, have been oppressing me who am overpowered with anxiety and grief.

sa: नकुल उवाच मृगराजो वृक्श्चैव बुद्धिमानपि मूषिकः॥ निर्जिता यत् त्वया वीरास्तमाद् वीरतरो भवान्। न त्वयाप्युत्सहे योद्धमित्युक्त्वा सोऽप्युपागमत्॥
en: The Mongoose said : When the king of the beasts (tiger) the wolf and the intelligent mouse have all been defeated by you, heroes as they are, you seem to be a greater hero than they. I do not desire (therefore) to fight with you: Saying this he went away.

sa: विह्वलं तमभिज्ञाय भर्तारं शरपीडितम्। हतोऽयमिति च ज्ञात्वा सारथिस्तमपावहत्॥
en: Seeing his master afflicted with darts and devoid of senses and taking him for dead his charioteer carried him off (from the field of battle).

sa: पारावतसवर्णाश्वं कोविदारवरध्वजम्। धृष्टद्युम्नं रणे दृष्ट्वा त्वदीयाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Seeing Dhrishtadyumna to whose car were yoked steeds white as pigeons and whose standard was made of lofty Kovidara, your troops fled away in fear.

sa: शिखण्डिनं द्वादशभिर्विंशत्या चौत्तमौजसम्। वसुदानं च भल्लेन प्रेषयद् यमसादनम्॥
en: He then struck Sikhandin with twelve arrows and Uttamaujas with twenty shafts, and with a broad-headed arrow he dispatched Vasudeva to the regions of Death.

sa: अशीत्या क्षत्रवर्माणं षडविंशत्या सुदक्षिणम्। क्षत्रदेवं तु भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत्॥
en: With eighty shafts he pierced Kshemavarman and with twenty-six he struck Sudakshina. With broad-headed shafts he brought down Kshetradeva from the terrace of his car.

sa: तदाग्नेयं महाघोरं रिपुघ्नमुपलक्ष्य सः॥ दिव्यमस्त्रं महेष्वासो वारुणं समुदैरयत्।
en: Beholding that dreadful and fiery dart capable of slaying the foe and of celestial make, that fierce bowman Satyaki invoked into existence the Varuna weapon.

sa: निश्चक्राम ततः श्रीमान् पुनरेव महायशाः। ददर्श ब्राह्मणांश्चैव सोऽभिरूपानवस्थितान्॥
en: Endued with great fame and prosperity, the king came out once more and saw a number of Brahmanas waiting with sacred articles in their hands.

sa: अतिकायश्च ते पुत्रो बालोऽतिबलवानयम्। कथमल्पेन कालेन शालस्तम्भ इवोद्गतः॥
en: Your this son is very big and appears to be very strong. How has he, within so short time, grown up like a Sala sprout?

sa: अथात्यर्थं विसृष्टेन द्विषतामसुभोजिना। आजघ्ने वक्षसि द्रोणो नाराचेन धनंजयम्॥
en: Then the preceptor pierced Dhananjaya on the breast with a Naracha discharged with great force and capable of sucking out the life of every foe.

sa: स तु कामाग्निसंतप्तः सुदेष्णामभिगम्य वै। प्रहसन्निव सेनानीरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Burning with the flame of lust, the leader of Virata's forces went to Sudeshna (his sister) and smilingly spoke to her in the following words.

sa: एवं वैरमभूत् तस्य क्षत्रियैर्लोकवासिभिः। पृथिवी चापि विजिता रामेणामिततेजसा॥
en: Thus did hostility arise between him and the Kshatriyas that lived on the earth. The entire world was thus conquered by the imineasurably effulgent Rama.

sa: तौ हृष्टवा प्रविविक्षन्तौ तव सेनामरिंदमौ। संयत्तास्तावकाः सर्वे तस्थुट्टैणपुरोगमाः॥
en: All your warriors ranged against them with Drona at their head, stood still and motionless. Then beholding Bhima accoutered in mail follow him from behind.

sa: नैवायं वानरान्राजन्न विजानाति राक्षसान्। मत्तः शोणितगन्धेन स्वान्परांश्चैव खादते॥
en: O king, this one know not monkeys and Rākşasas, maddened with the smell of blood, he eat up his own as well as his enemies.

sa: ततस्तु वैतहव्यानां वधाय स महीपतिः। पुत्रं प्रस्थापयामास प्रतर्दनमरिंदमम्॥
en: After this, the old king commanded that chastiser of foes, viz., prince Pratarddana, to march against the sons of Vitahavya and kill them in battle.

sa: तदनादृत्य ते सर्वे शरैरभ्यहनस्तदा। तमोरजोभ्यां संछन्नांस्तान् किरीटी न्यवारयत्॥
en: Disregarding Arjuna's message, they attacked him with their arrows. The diadem decked Arjuna resisted those warriors who were under the control of darkness and passion.

sa: तार्क्ष्य उवाच क्षेत्रज्ञभूतां परलोकभावे कर्मोदये बुद्धिमतिप्रविष्टाम्। प्रज्ञां च देवीं सुभगे विमृश्य पृच्छामि त्वां का ह्यसि चारुरूपे॥
en: Tarkshya said: O Goddess! having attracting complexion you are in the form of soul and the supreme wisdom inserted in metaphysics and the topics related to the consequence of action. You too are a goddess of conscience Assuming you in this both forms I ask the real identity of yours.

sa: यत्ता मदर्थे तिष्ठन्ति कुरुवीराभिरक्षिताः। अप्रमत्ता महाराज मामेव प्रत्युपस्थिताः॥
en: And expectantly looking for me, awaiting my arrival, being supported by numerous Kuru heroes. They are all coolheaded, O monarch and long to receive me.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। गीतं दृष्टार्थतत्त्वेन वामदेवेन धीमता॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story of what the highly intelligent Vamadeva acquainted with the true import of everything sang in days of yore.

sa: शैलाने रचिता दुर्गा सा पूर्देवपुरोपमा। वाजिवारणसंपूर्णा लङ्का परमदुर्जया॥
en: That citadel is built on the mountain's brow; and, resembling the metropolis of the immortals, the exceedingly invincible Larkā is filled with horses and elephants.

sa: ततो मद्राधिपः क्रुद्धः शरेणानतपर्वणा। आजधानोरसि दृढं विराटं वाहिनीपतिम्॥
en: Therefore the king of Madra, inflamed with wrath, struck Virata, the chief of a large force, furiously in the chest with a hundred straight arrows.

sa: ततो द्रोण: पौत्रं चित्रैः सर्वायसैः शरैः। त्रिभिराशीविपाकरैर्ललाटे समविध्यत॥
en: Then Drona pierced Sini's grandson on the forehead with three beautiful shafts wholly made or iron and looking like so many snakes of virulent poison.

sa: तदैवाज्ञासिषं शत्रून् हतान् प्राप्तां च मेदिनीम्॥ त्वत्प्रसादसमुत्थेन विक्रमेणारिसूदन।
en: Endowed with prosperity, obtained sovereignty over the three world in battle. And O lord of the celestials, it is also through favour that the celestials.

sa: स्वान्यनीकानि मृद्गन्त आर्तनादाः प्रदुद्रुवुः॥ हयाच पतितारोहाः पत्तयश्च नराधिप।
en: Began to fly away uttering shrieks of pain and crushing their own ranks under heath their feat. Riderless steeds and foot soldiers also, O monarch.

sa: एष सर्वात्मना पाण्डूंस्त्रासयित्वा महारणे। अभिभाषित राधेयः सर्वसैन्यानि मानद॥
en: Having thus terrified the Pandavas in the great battle with all his force, the son of Radha, O giver of honor, addressing his army said-

sa: तावकाश्च महाराज कर्णपुत्रश्च दंशितः। सात्यकि विव्यधुस्तूर्णं समन्तान्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: So also Yuyudhana that foremost of the Vrishni warriors, covered Karna with his shower of arrows. The combat was an equal one (in all respects).

sa: स तु तं प्रतिविव्याध त्रिभिस्तीक्ष्णैरजिह्मगैः। स्वर्णपुङ्खः शिलाधौतैः प्राणान्तकरणैर्युधि॥
en: Inflamed with fury, O king, Drumasena then pierced Dhristadyumna with an arrow and then again quickly piercing the latter with sharp shafts he said-"wait, wait."

sa: आसीद् राजन् बलौघानां तदान्योन्यमभिघ्नताम्। सौमदत्तिवधात् क्रुद्धो दृष्ट्वा सात्यकिमाहवे॥
en: There arose a great tumult among the combatants striking each other. Seeing Satyaki in battle and enraged at the slaughter of the son of Somadatta,

sa: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां मुहूर्ताद् द्विजसत्तमः। क्रोधेन महताऽऽविष्टो वायव्यास्रमवासृजत्॥
en: Then regaining his consciousness, heaving sighs like a snake and excited with a terrible wrath, he brought into existence the weapon presided over by Vayu.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं त्वरमाणो महीपतिः॥ सायकैर्दशभी राजन् भ्रुवोर्मध्ये समार्पयत्।
en: Then, O lord of the earth, the king penetrated ten arrows into the forehead of his assailant whose bow had already been cut-off by him.

sa: उभौ वरायुधरावुभौ रणकृतश्रमौ। उभौ च बाहुशब्देन नादयन्तौ नभस्तलम्॥
en: They were both skilful in war and possessed of select weapons and they made the skies ring back with the noise of sounding their arm-pits.

sa: सारथिं चास्य विंशत्या स्वर्णपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः। हयांश्च चतुरोऽविध्यचतुर्भिनिशितैः शरैः॥
en: He pierced the latter's charioteer with twenty shafts furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone and the four horses with four very sharp arrows.

sa: अभिद्रुत्य च विंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां नरर्षभ। पञ्चभिश्चातिवेगेन विव्याध पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Thus assailing him, that foremost of men, at first pierced his enemy with twenty small arrows and then again with five others, with great force.

sa: कृतवर्मा ततो राजन्नुत्तमौजसमाहवे। हृदि विव्याध सहसा रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्॥
en: Then Kritavarma, in that battle, O king, all on a sudden struck Uttamouja on the breast at which the latter sank down on his car.

sa: स महास्त्रैर्महाराज द्रोणमाच्छादयद् रणे। निहत्य सर्वाण्यस्राणि भारद्वाजस्य पार्षतः॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, Dhristadyumna covered Drona in that battle with many weapons. Destroying all those weapons of Bharadvaja's son, the prince of the Panchalas.

sa: तथा ते राक्षसाः सर्वे भीमसेनमुपाद्रवन्। नानाप्रहरणा भीमास्त्वत्सुतानां जयैषिणः॥
en: On the other hand all these Rakshasas, armed with various weapons and dreadfullooking, assailed Bhimasena from all sides desirous of securing victory to your sons.

sa: हतशेषं बलं तत् तु पाण्डवानामतिष्ठत। अस्रव्युपरमासृष्टं तव पुत्रजिघांसया॥
en: Then the remnant of the Pandava troops, beholding the subsidence of the energy of that weapon, again stood ready in order to slay your sons.

sa: पुनश्च विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विद्ध्वा मर्मसु पञ्चभिः। धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: Once more, O sire, piercing him on his vital parts with five sharp arrows, Bhima severed the bow of Suta's son with a broad-headed shaft.

sa: पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च दिशश्चैव समावृणोत्। तथैव पाञ्चजन्योऽपि वासुदेवसमीरितः॥
en: Filled the earth, the skies and the ten points of the compass. So also the blast of the Panchajanya, blown by the son of Vasudeva.

sa: सखिभावेन सौहार्दान्मित्रभावेन चैव हि। कारणैस्त्रिभिरेतैस्त्वं शल्य जीवसि साम्प्रतम्॥
en: Out of friendship for you, out of my affection and on account of your being an ally-for these three reasons, you still live, O Shalya.

sa: दीप्ताभै रत्नवद्भिश्च पतितैर्गजयोधिभिः॥ रराज भूमिः पतितैः क्षीणपुण्यैरिव ग्रहैः।
en: With fallen elephant warriors, shining and adorned with jewels and the earth shone beautiful as if covered with planets dropped for the wane of virtue.

sa: संशयः सर्वभूतानां विजये समपद्यत। समेतौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ प्रेक्ष्य कर्णधनंजयौ॥
en: Beholding those foremost of men Karna and Dhananjaya engaged in combat, it could not be said as to who would be victorious in the end.

sa: एकचक्रमिवार्कस्य रथं सप्त हया यथा॥ अमृष्यमाणः कर्णस्तु भीमसेनमयुध्यता
en: Like the single-wheeled car of the Sun borne by the seven celestial steeds. Then not tolerating the feats of Bhimasena Karna fought on which latter.

sa: घटोत्कचशरैर्नुना तथैव तव वाहिनी। निशीथे प्राद्रवद् राजन्नुत्सृज्योल्काः सहस्रशः॥
en: Began to disperse in that night, like masses of clouds torn away by a furious gale. Similarly your troops mangled with the arrows of Ghatotkacha.

sa: सामुद्रश्चिसेनश्च सह पुत्रेण भारत॥ समुद्रसेनेन बलाद् गमितो यमसादनम्।
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, Chitrasena, dwelling in the sea-coast, was means forcibly sent with his son, to the region of Yama by Samudrasena.

sa: वर्धयिष्यामि भूयस्त्वां विजितारिं हतद्विषम्। तमर्जुनः प्रत्युवाच प्रसादात् तव माधव॥ प्रतिज्ञेयं मया तीर्णा विबुधैरपि दुस्तरा। अनाश्चर्यो जयस्तेषां येषां नाथोऽसि केशव॥ त्वत्प्रसादान्महीं कृत्स्नां सम्प्राप्स्यति युधिष्ठिरः। तव प्रभावो वार्ष्णेय तवैव विजयः प्रभो। वर्धनीयास्तव वयं सदैव मधुसूदन॥ एवमुक्तस्ततः कृष्णः शनकैर्वाहयन् हयान्। दर्शयामास पार्थाय क्रूरमायोधनं महत्॥
en: o destroyer of Madhu, you are (ever) concerned in our welfare and we are always) at your enemy." Arjuna then replied to him (thus)-"O Madhava, through your favour, I have fulfilled the vow, which even by the celestials can with difficulty be performed. O Keshava, it is no wonder that they, who have you for their lord, will win the victory. Through your favour Yudhishthira will recover the entire earth. O descendant of Vrishnis, (as) all this is due to your power, (so) O lord, this victory is yours. O destroyer of Madhu, you are (ever) concerned in our welfare wand we are (always) at your service.” Thus spoken to Krishna with a smile, slowly guided the steeds and showed to Partha the greatly cruel field of battle.

sa: अनूपवासी नीलश्च व्याघ्रदत्तश्च वीर्यवान्॥ अश्वत्थाम्ना विकर्णेन गमितो यमसादनम्।
en: O powerful monarch, Neela, the dweller of Anupa and Vyaghradatta, endued with great prowess, both these were sent to the abode of Yama by Ashvatthaman.

sa: दुःशासनस्ततश्चापं छित्वा राजन् महाहवे। सहदेवं त्रिसप्तत्या बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon, O king, Dushasana, after having severed his bow in that dreadful battle, struck Shahadeva with seventy-three arrows both in the arms and the chest.

sa: तौ न्यवारयतां श्रेष्ठौ संरब्धौ रणशोभिनौ। उदीरयेतां ब्राह्माणि दिव्यान्यस्राण्यनेकशः॥
en: Those two ornaments of battle, those two superior warriors, filled with rage, then resisted one another and invoked into existence many celestial and Brahma weapons.

sa: ततोऽभूत् तुमुलं युद्धे भीमराधेययोस्तदा। तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ विवृत्तनयनावुभौ॥
en: Thereupon tremendous combat commenced between Bhima and the son of Radha. Both the combatants then roared like two bulls and their eyes rolled in fury.

sa: सूतपुत्रो रणे क्रुद्धः पाण्डवानापनीकिनीम्॥ भीमसेनः कुरुश्चापि द्रावयन्तौ विरेजतुः।
en: Suta's son, filled with anger, routed the Pandava army while the enraged Bhimasena routed the Kurus. And both the heroes thus engaged looked exceedingly beautiful.

sa: ततो यास्याम्यहं वीर स्वयं कर्णजिघांसया। भीमसेनो महाबाहुर्दोणानीकेन सङ्गतः॥
en: Therefore, O hero, I will fight for compassing the death of Suta's son. The mighty-armed Bhima has already engaged himself with the division of Drona."

sa: सच्छिन्नयष्टिः सुमहाशीर्यमाणो महाध्वजः। पपात प्रमुखे राजन् युयुत्सोः काञ्चनध्वजः॥
en: O monarch, that huge and magnificent standard, that one made of gold, being torn off and shattered into fragments, dropped down in front of Yuyutsu.

sa: व्यासेनैवमथोक्तस्तु धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। स्वयं कर्णवधाद् वीरो निवृत्तो भरतर्षभ॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to by Vyasa the very virtuous king Yudhishthira, endued with heroism, desisted himself from slaughtering Karna, O foremost of the Bharatas.

sa: तौ हताश्वौ हतरथौ पाण्डवौ भृशविक्षतौ। भ्रातरावारुरुहतुः सहदेवरथं तदा॥
en: Then those sons of Pandu, the two brothers (Yudhishthira and Nakula) greatly wounded, got upon Sahadeva's car after their horses and car had been destroyed.

sa: पुनरस्य त्वरन् भीमो नाराचान् दश भारत। रणे प्रैषीन्महाबाहुर्निमुक्ताशीविषोपमान्॥
en: Then once more, O Bharata, the mighty armed Bhima sped at him with great quickness ten Narachas resembling snakes just first freed from the sloughs.

sa: पुरेषु चाभवन् राजन् राजानो वै पृथक्-पृथक्। काञ्चनं तारकाक्षस्यचित्रमासीन्महात्मनः॥
en: O monarch, separate kings lived in those cities. The one of gold that was most beautiful had been in the possession of the high-souled Tarakaksha.

sa: पुनश्चेदीदृशं वाक्यं मद्रराज वदिष्यसि॥ शिरस्ते पातयिष्यामि गदया वज्रकल्पया।
en: O king of Madras, if you speak again in this strain I will crush down your head with my mace, as hard as the thunder.

sa: अभ्यद्रवद् द्रुतं कर्णः पृष्ठतो विकिरञ्छरान्॥ अवेक्षमाणास्त्वन्योन्यं सुसम्मूढा विचेतसः।
en: Karna pursued them from behind shooting his arrows in all directions. Those warriors as they were madly flying, were carnaged by thousands, in that battle.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा साम्ना परमवल्गुना। तानाभाष्य महेष्वासान् प्राप्तकालमभाषत।॥
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana addressed these mighty bowmen in the most agreeable and pleasant terms and spoke them in a way most suited to the time.

sa: प्रापयाश्वान् महाबाहो सत्यसेनं प्रति प्रभो। यावदेनं शैरस्तीक्ष्णैर्नयामि यमसादनम्॥
en: “O mighty armed lord, drive the steeds towards Satyasena that I may send this one to the abode of Death by means of sharp arrows.

sa: धनंजयस्ततः कृष्णमब्रवीत् पश्य केशव। आचार्यरथमुख्यानां मध्ये क्रीडन् मधूद्वहः॥
en: Thereafter Dhananjaya addressing Kesava said-"Behold, O Kesava, that perpetuator of Madhu's race, sporting amidst the hostile warriors headed by the preceptor and other foremost car-warriors.

sa: ततस्ते प्राद्रवन् भीताःपुत्रास्ते विह्वलीकृताः॥ भीमसेनं रणे दृष्टा कालान्तकयमोपमम्।
en: Beholding Bhimasena in battle behave like the Destroyer himself at the end of Yuga your sons, worked up greatly with fear, took to their heels.

sa: गदाभिरन्ये गुर्वीभिः परिधैर्मुसलैरपि। पोथिताः शतश: पेतुर्वीरा वीरतरै द्विपैः॥
en: While other heroic warriors, having been smitten by heroes of greater prowess with heavy maces, spiked clubs and maces, fell in the battle by hundreds.

sa: गजारोहा गजैस्तूर्णं संनिपत्य महामृधे। योधयन्तश्च मृद्गन्तः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Hundreds and thousands of warriors, mounted on elephants, speedily encountering riders on elephants in that great engagement, began to fight with and crush one another.

sa: ते दह्यमाना द्रोणेन सूर्येणेव विराजता। दग्धवीर्या निरुत्साहा बभूवुर्गतचेतसः॥
en: Our enemies, then scorched by Drona who then appeared beautiful like the sun, were reduced in their energy, deprived of courage and depressed at heart.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं हताश्वं हतसारथिम्॥ विव्याध सायकैः पार्थश्चतुर्भिः पाण्डुनन्दनः।
en: Then Partha, the son of Pandu pierced that one (i.e., Karna) deprived on his steeds and driver and whose bow was cut-off with four arrows.

sa: भीमसेनप्रभावात्तु यजीवामि धनंजय। बहुनात्र किमक्तेन नाहं तत् सोढुमुत्सहे॥
en: It is through Bhima's power that I do still survive, O Dhananjaya; what more need I say? The humiliation is indeed too much for me.

sa: हत्वा विंशतिसाहस्रान् पञ्चालानां रथव्रजान्। अतिष्ठदाहवे द्रोणो विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: Having slain twenty thousand car-warriors of the Panchalas, Drona stood on the battlefield like a blazing fire free from even a single curl of smoke.

sa: धनंजय शिरश्छिन्धि सैन्धवस्य दुरात्मनः॥ अस्तं महीधरश्रेष्ठं यियासति दिवाकरः।
en: O Dhananjaya quickly cut-off the head of the wicked-souled ruler of the Sindhus. The sun is on the point of going to the Western hills.

sa: भानुसेनं च दशभिः साश्वसूतायुधध्वजम्। पश्यतां सुहृदां मध्ये कर्णपुत्रमपातयत्।॥
en: Then with ten other arrows Bhima struck down Bhanusena, another son of Karna, with horses, drivers, arms and flags before the eyes of his friends.

sa: तत्र वीरो महेष्वासः सात्यकियुद्धदुर्मदः। निचकर्त शिरांस्युग्रैः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Then that mighty bowman, the heroic Satyaki of indomitable prowess, began to lop off the heads of his foes with fierce shafts of depressed knots.

sa: तौ दृष्ट्वा प्रतिसंरब्धौ दुर्योधनधनंजयौ। अभ्यवैक्षन्त राजानो भीमरूपाः समन्ततः॥
en: Then beholding Duryodhana and Dhananjaya, both enraged against each other, all the royal warriors of fierce appearance, began to look at them from all sides.

sa: एवं कान्तमना राजन्नुपायाद् द्रोणमीक्षितुम्। आगस्कृत् सर्वलोकस्य पुत्रस्ते भरतर्षभ॥
en: Thus dejected at heart, O king, O the most exalted of the Bharatas, your son, the offender against the whole world, came to seen Drona.

sa: य इष्ट्वा मनुजेन्द्रेण दुपदेन महामखे। लब्धो द्रोणविनाशाय समिद्धाद्धव्यवाहनात्॥
en: That hero had, for the slaughter of Drona, been obtained by Drupada, that ruler of men, at a great sacrifice, from the God of Fire.

sa: वासुदेवो रथात् तूर्णमवतीर्य महाद्युतिः। मोचयामास तुरगान् विनुन्नान् कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: The highly effulgent son of Vasudeva descending down quickly from the chariot unharnessed the horses lacerated with arrows furnished with wings of the Kanka feathers.

sa: अपूजयन् महेष्वासा धार्तराष्ट्रा नरोत्तमम्॥ कर्णं रथवरश्रेष्ठं श्रेष्ठं सर्वधनुष्मताम्।
en: And O lordly being, all the great warriors of the Dhritarasthra force paid him their homage and worshipped him as the best of all bowmen.

sa: वरूथिन्यामनृत्येतां परिष्वज्य परस्परम्। अब्रवीच तदा भीमः पार्षतं शत्रुतापनम्॥
en: Embraced each other in the midst of the Pandava host which looked upon them both. Then that afflicter of foes Bhima addressing Prisata's son said

sa: एवमाचर कौन्तेय धर्मराजे युधिष्ठिरे। अधर्मयुक्तं संयोग कुरुष्वैन कुरूद्वह॥
en: O the best of Kurus, O son of Kunti, do behave thus towards Yudhishthira the righteous and insult that honorable man by this censurable behaviour.

sa: एकाग्रमिव चासीच ज्योतिर्भिः पूरितं नमः। समपद्यत चार्काभे भारद्वाजदिवाकरे॥
en: The whole welkin was ablaze and appeared to be one vast sheet of equal light when the sun-like Bharadvaja, of solar splendour, proceeded towards heaven.

sa: क्रोधं परममातस्थौ समरे रुधिरोक्षितः। दृढं सोऽभिहतस्तेन पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥
en: Became excited to the highest pitch of anger, steeped as he was with profuse blood. Wounded deeply and firmly by the high-souled son of Pandu.

sa: ततः कर्णो महाराज धनुश्छित्त्वा महात्मनः। सारथिं पातयामास रथनीडाद्धसन्निव॥
en: Then, O powerful monarch, Karna after having severed the bow of that high-souled one (Nakula), smilingly caused the fall of his charioteer from the car-nichi.

sa: शल्य उवाच आत्मनिन्दाऽऽत्मपूला च परनिन्दा परस्तवः। अनाचरितमार्याणां वृत्तमेतचतुर्विधम्॥
en: Shalya said The most respectable personages believe in these four different ways, which are enumerated thus-self-blame, or self-praise and speaking ill or well of others.

sa: कर्णस्तु सात्यकि जित्वां राजगृद्धी महाबलः॥ द्रोणहन्तारमुग्रेषु ससारभिमुखो रणे।
en: In the meantime, the greatly powerful Karna, having killed Satyaki, proceeded straight on towards the slayer of Drona for the rescue of the Kuru king.

sa: वृद्धौ च मातापितरौ बिभर्त्यन्यांश्च संश्रितान्। स्वधर्मनिरतो नित्यं सत्यवागनसूयकः॥
en: Devoted to his tribal pursuits, always speaking the truth and devoid of malice, he used to maintain his aged mother and father and other dependents.

sa: प्रवृत्तौ शरसम्पातं कर्तुं पुरुषसत्तमौ। ततो रथसहस्रेण नागानामयुतेन च।॥
en: Those two foremost of men began to discharge arrows (at each other, Then with a thousand cars and ten thousand cars and ten thousand horses.

sa: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म ज्योतिर्भूतो महातपाः। स्मरित्वा देवदेवेशमक्षरं परमं प्रभुम्॥
en: And thinking on the monosyllabic Om representing Brahma and recollecting the mighty, paramount and indestructible god of gods and effulgent Drona of great ascetic merit.

sa: कृष्णपार्थो महेष्वासौ व्यतिक्रम्याथ ते अग्रतः पुण्डरीकाक्षं प्रतीयाय नराधिप॥
en: Leaving behind him the two mighty carwarriors Krishna and Partha, your son proceeded ahead and then turned back, p king, facing Keshava of lotus-like eyes.

sa: तदुत्सृज्य धनुश्छिन्नं चेदिराजो महारथः। शक्ति जग्राह विपुलां हेमदण्डामयस्मयीम्॥
en: Thereupon that mighty car-warrior the ruler of the Chedis, leaving aside the severed bow took up a huge lance of golden staff and iron head.

sa: अतिक्रमेच माहात्म्याद् दिष्टमप्यर्थपर्ययम्। अतिक्रान्ते च लोकानामभावो नियतं भवेत्॥
en: By his great prowess Partha can overrule destiny itself whether it be in his favour or not; when he means he can destroy all creatures.

sa: नराश्वकायैः संछन्ना भूमिरासीद् विशाम्पते। रुधिरोदकचित्रा च भीरूणां भयवर्धिनी॥
en: The earth, O king, was covered with the bodies of men and horses and over-flown with rivers of blood that struck terror to the timid,

sa: तौ तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय महर्षी लोकपूजितौ॥ संजयं श्वैत्यमभ्येत्य राजानमिदमूचतुः।
en: Coming at that understanding, those two great Rishis, worshipped of all the worlds, repaired to King Srinjaya the son of Shitya and said to him?

sa: स बालस्तेजसा युक्तः सूतपुत्रत्वमागतः। चकाराङ्गिरसां श्रेष्ठाद् धनुर्वेदं गुरोस्तदा॥
en: Highly energetic that child became known as a Suta. He subsequently learnt the science of arms from the preceptor (Drona), that foremost of Angirasa's race.

sa: यो ह्यनाढ्यः स पतितस्तदुच्छिष्टं यदल्पकम्॥ बह्वपथ्यं बलवति न किंचित् क्रियते भयात्। उभौ सत्यधिकारस्थौ त्रायते महतो भयात्॥
en: He is truly degraded who has no wealth. A little is considered as the filthy residue of a feast. If a strong men commits even many bed deeds, nobody, through fear, speaks ill of him. If Righteousness and Power be associated with Truth, they can save men from great dangers.

sa: ब्राह्मणो जायमानो हि पृथिव्यामनुजायते। ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां धर्मकोशस्य गुप्तये॥
en: Thus created the Brahmana is born on Earth as the lord of all creatures, his duty being to preserve the Vedas and the other scriptures.

sa: नामित्रो विनिकर्तव्यो नातिच्छेद्यः कथञ्चन। जीवितं ह्यष्यतिच्छिन्नः संत्यजेच्च कदाचन॥
en: An enemy should not be imposed on by unfair means. Nor should he be wounded morally. For if struck morally, his very life may disappear.

sa: अहमेकोऽवशिष्टस्तु तस्मात् सैन्यान्महामते। मुक्तः कथंचिद् धर्मात्मन् व्यग्राच कृतवर्मणः॥
en: I am the sole survivor, O king, of that vast host. I have escaped with difficulty from Kritavarman at a time when he was careless.

sa: कृष्णौ चापि महेष्वासावभिवाद्य हलायुधम्॥ सस्वजाते परिप्रीतौ प्रीयमाणौ यशस्विनौ।
en: Those great bowmen, viz., viz., the illustrious Krishnas, filled with joy, cheerfully saluted the hero who had the plough for his weapon and embraced him.

sa: युधिष्ठिरेण निहतं शल्यं समितिशोभनम्। रुदत्यः पर्युपासन्ते मद्रराजं कुलाङ्गनाः॥
en: the ladies of the royal house of Madra, crying aloud, are sitting around the body of that king, that ornament of assemblies, killed by Yudhishthira.

sa: राजानमनुवर्तन्ते तं पापाभिप्रवर्तकम्। अविनीतमनुष्यं तत् क्षिप्रं राष्ट्र विनश्यति॥
en: Others, again, imitate that wretch who commits sins. Such imitation of the man who does not care for restraints soon brings destruction upon the kingdom.

sa: तच्छुत्वा वाक्यमशिवं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। पपात मह्यां दुर्धर्षः पुत्रशोकसमन्वितः॥
en: Hearing this evil news, Kunti's son Yudhishthira, however endued with fortitude, dropped down on the Earth, stricken with grief at the loss of his sons.

sa: तासामयं समुद्योगो निर्वृत्तः केवलोऽफलः।१६।। यदासां निहताः पुत्रा युवानो मृष्टकुण्डलाः। अभुक्त्वा पार्थिवान् भोगानृणान्यनपहाय च॥ पितृभ्यो देवताभ्यश्च गता वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: But, all these acts became fruitless. Alas, since their young sons, wearing shining carrings, have been killed, therefore, their hopes have not been realised. Without having enjoyed the sweets of this world, and without having paid off the debts they owed to their fathers and the gods, they have gone to Yama's abode.
